meta_description: Business Bay hotels from €86 to €290 a night, compared on score, room size, pools and breakfast cost, from canal-view rooms to serviced studios.
h1: 10 Best Hotels in Business Bay, Dubai (2026)
h1_main: 10 Best Hotels in Business Bay, Dubai in 2026
author_role: 10 Business Bay hotels and apartments compared on price, guest score, room size, pools and breakfast
lead: For most stays in Business Bay, book Embassy Suites by Hilton at €186 a night: it is the only 5-star here with breakfast for two in its cheapest rate, plus an infinity pool and free cancellation. On a budget, Park Regis gives you a canal-view room and a rooftop pool for €91; for a splurge, SLS Dubai at €212 has 46 m² balcony rooms and seven restaurants.

We compared ten hotels and serviced apartments on the same night: price, guest score, location score, pools, breakfast cost and room size. Filter by apartments, families or budget below, or jump to the table.
price_note: Lowest nightly rate for 2 adults on 13–14 January 2027. Dates, room type and board change it; taxes and the Dubai tourism fee are added at booking.

pills.label: In 15:00 · out 12:00
pills.body: Check-in from 15:00, check-out until 12:00. The minimum check-in age is 18 and the hotel takes cards only, no cash.

pills.label: 34 m² King Guest Room
pills.body: The €186 rate is the King Guest Room (366 ft², about 34 m²) with an extra-large double bed, city view, bath, minibar and coffee maker. Corner King Rooms with Burj Khalifa view start at €191.

pills.body: The €186 card rate already includes breakfast for two, with free cancellation and pay at the property. Breakfast has fresh pastries, pancakes and fruit.

pills.label: Infinity pool
pills.body: Year-round outdoor infinity pool, spa and wellness centre with massage and sauna, and a fitness room.

pills.label: Burj Khalifa suites
pills.body: One-bedroom suites with two double beds and Burj Khalifa view (527 ft²) and Superior King Suites up to 743 ft² with a sofa bed in the living room.

pills.label: Polished family base
pills.body: A big-brand 5-star on Marasi Drive with 3 restaurants, free private parking and a 9.5 for comfort and staff.

items.skip: if you want a kitchen: rooms have a minibar and coffee maker only, so look at #4 or #5.

review: This is the strongest all-round booking in Business Bay for the money. €186 a night buys a 5-star room with breakfast for two included, free cancellation and no prepayment. At SLS (#3) and InterContinental Residences (#4) the cheapest rate is €210–212 before you add breakfast, which costs €37 at the InterContinental.

The King Guest Room is about 34 m² with a bath and city view. Pay €5 more and the Corner King Room adds a Burj Khalifa view; families can step up to a one-bedroom suite with two double beds and a sofa bed in the living room.

It also has the clearest family set-up of the 5-stars here: a children's buffet, indoor and outdoor play areas, free cots for under-3s and an infinity pool. Guests score it 9.5 for cleanliness, comfort and staff and 9.2 for location.
Catches: no kitchen in the standard rooms, cash is not accepted, and VAT, the municipality fee and tourism fee are added at booking.

review: If you want the best score per euro in Business Bay, this is it. €91 a night for a 9.0-rated hotel with a heated rooftop pool, and the cheapest room faces the canal. The rate also comes with free cancellation and 20% off food and drink.

Breakfast is €17, half of what Hotel Indigo (#7) charges and less than half the InterContinental's €37. Even with breakfast added you stay far below Embassy Suites (#1), which charges €186 with breakfast in the rate.

What the price leaves out: the standard room is about 30 m², the bathroom has a shower rather than a bath, and the Food Souk restaurant is listed for breakfast and lunch only. Burj Khalifa is 3 km away.
Taxes are listed per stay here: VAT, a municipality fee and a tourism fee of AED 14.99 come on top.

items.skip: if you need breakfast in the price: the €212 rate is room only, and the breakfast-included rate is non-refundable.

review: SLS is the one to book when the hotel is part of the trip. €212 gets a 46 m² room with a balcony, among the biggest entry rooms of the ten, plus two pools, a rooftop infinity pool and seven restaurants including Fi'lia and the Carna steakhouse.

Against ME by Meliá (#10), the other design-led splurge, it is €78 cheaper a night, scores higher (9.1 vs 8.8) and adds a balcony to a room only 1 m² smaller. Against Embassy Suites (#1) you pay €26 more and lose the included breakfast, but gain the rooftop scene and bigger rooms.

Watch the rate you pick: the €212 card rate is room only and shows no free cancellation; flexible room-only rates were €236 with pay at the property, and the breakfast-included rate is non-refundable. a 10% service charge, 5% VAT, the 7% municipality fee and the AED 20 per night tourism fee are added on top.

review: The InterContinental Residences has the highest guest score of the ten (9.5), and 9.7 for cleanliness and comfort. For €210 you get a 48 m² studio with a full kitchenette: stovetop, oven, fridge, kitchenware and a dining table.

That makes it the natural pick for a week or more, or for families who want to cook breakfast. Kids get their own pool, cots are free up to age 2, and there are free bikes. Compared with Lusso Missoni (#5), you pay €81 more for a 5-star brand, a bigger studio and hotel services, but lose the washing machine and balcony.

Pick the rate carefully: the cheapest is non-refundable, free cancellation starts at €234 with breakfast extra (€37). a 10% service charge, 5% VAT, the 7% municipality fee and the AED 20 per night tourism fee are added on top.

review: Lusso's apartments sit in the Urban Oasis by Missoni tower on Marasi Drive, and they score 9.3, second only to the InterContinental Residences. The €129 studio is about 41 m² with a balcony, city view, kitchenette and dishwasher.

It beats DAMAC Maison Aykon (#6) on space and score for €1 less a night, and the washing machine is a real plus on a long stay. Against the InterContinental (#4) you save €81 a night and keep a heated rooftop infinity pool.

The trade-offs are apartment ones: breakfast comes to your room rather than a buffet, there are no extra beds, and you hand over an AED 400 cash deposit at check-in. Taxes and charges come on top of the €129.

review: DAMAC Maison Aykon City is the family pick: three outdoor pools, a kids' club, a play room and a games room, with a kitchenette in every studio for €130. Nearly 9,700 guest reviews average 9.0, so the score is about as reliable as it gets in Business Bay.

The studio is about 38 m², 3 m² smaller than Lusso (#5) for €1 more, but you get hotel facilities Lusso lacks. Embassy Suites (#1) is the hotel alternative with play areas and breakfast in the rate, at €56 more a night.
Location is the trade-off: it is on Sheikh Zayed Road at AYKON City rather than on the canal. Budget for the AED 700 card deposit and taxes on top of the €130.

It is the cheapest 5-star of the ten and welcomes pets with a basket and bowls (SLS and ME take them on request only). Free cancellation starts at €115, still €71 under Embassy Suites (#1), though Embassy includes breakfast and Indigo charges €34.
Its location score (8.9) is the lowest here, by a small margin. a 10% service charge, 5% VAT, the 7% municipality fee and the AED 20 per night tourism fee are added on top.

More than 7,000 guest reviews average 8.9 and 9.4 for staff. Free cancellation and pay at the property are available; taxes and charges come on top.

guide.h2: Business Bay Hotels Compared: Price, Score and Room Size
guide.html:
All ten are priced for the same night for 2 adults, cheapest room, before taxes. Six of them (Embassy Suites, Lusso, DAMAC Aykon, Canal Central, Barceló and ME by Meliá) were limited-time deal rates that night, so expect those to rise when the deal ends. The spread is wide: €86 at Barceló to €290 at ME by Meliá, yet guest scores sit in a tight 8.8–9.5 band, so paying more buys space, pools and restaurants rather than a better-run hotel.

What the numbers say: the best score per euro is Park Regis (9.0 for €91). Embassy Suites is the only one with breakfast in the cheapest rate. The biggest entry rooms are at the InterContinental Residences (48 m²), ME by Meliá (47 m²) and SLS (46 m²); the smallest is Barceló (25 m²). Location scores barely differ (8.9–9.4), so pick on price, room and facilities.

guide.h2: Which Business Bay Hotel Should You Book?
guide.html:
• Most people: Embassy Suites by Hilton, €186 with breakfast for two, infinity pool, free cancellation.
  • Tight budget: Park Regis (€91, rooftop pool, €17 breakfast) or Barceló (€86, free Dubai Mall shuttle).
  • Splurge: SLS Dubai for rooftop pools and seven restaurants; ME by Meliá if you want to stay inside Zaha Hadid's Opus.
  • A week or more, or self-catering: InterContinental Residences (48 m² studio, 9.5 score) or Lusso Missoni (€129, washing machine, balcony).
  • Families: DAMAC Maison Aykon City for three pools and a kids' club, Canal Central for a kids' pool plus free Palm beach access.
  • With a pet: Hotel Indigo allows pets and provides a basket and bowls; SLS and ME by Meliá accept them on request.

If you would rather wake up next to Burj Khalifa and Dubai Mall and pay more for it, compare our best hotels in Downtown Dubai. For the city's top 5-star resorts and beach hotels, see the best luxury hotels in Dubai.

guide.h2: Hotel or Serviced Apartment in Business Bay?
guide.html:
Three apartment-style stays made the list. For the same money as a hotel room you usually get more space and a kitchen:

  • Lusso Missoni, €129: 41 m² studio with balcony, kitchenette, dishwasher and washing machine.
  • DAMAC Maison Aykon City, €130: 38 m² studio with kitchenette, plus hotel extras like three pools and a kids' club.
  • InterContinental Residences, €210: 48 m² studio with stovetop and oven, inside a 5-star with full hotel service.

The catch with apartments is the deposit and fewer services: Lusso takes AED 400 in cash at check-in and DAMAC AED 700 on your card, and neither has the restaurant choice of SLS or Embassy Suites. For 1–3 nights a hotel is usually simpler; for 4+ nights the kitchen and laundry pay back.

guide.h2: Where to Stay in Business Bay, Getting Around and What Costs Extra
guide.html:
Which part of Business Bay: Embassy Suites, SLS, the InterContinental Residences, Lusso Missoni and Hotel Indigo all sit on Marasi Drive, so you can compare them on room and price alone. Park Regis is at Park Lane Towers, Canal Central on Al Abraj Street, Barceló on Al Asayel Street, ME by Meliá in The Opus, and DAMAC Maison on Sheikh Zayed Road at AYKON City.

Getting around: Dubai International Airport is 14–16 km from all ten. ME by Meliá is 1.7 km from The Dubai Fountain and 2.4 km from Dubai Mall; Park Regis is 3 km from Burj Khalifa. Barceló's rate includes free shuttles to Dubai Mall and Kite Beach, and Canal Central's Superior Room includes free access to its private beach on Palm Jumeirah. Nine of the ten list free private parking.

What costs extra: prices here exclude taxes. At the IHG and SLS hotels the rooms table adds a 10% service charge, 5% VAT, a 7% municipality fee and an AED 20 per night tourism fee. Breakfast runs from €17 (Park Regis) to €37 (InterContinental Residences). Apartments and several hotels take a refundable damage deposit, from AED 200 at Park Regis to AED 750 at SLS. Extra beds cost AED 100–180 a night where offered.

Plan the days: Burj Khalifa is a short ride from every hotel here; compare deck times in our Burj Khalifa tickets guide. For evenings, the best dinner cruises in Dubai and, for a day out of the city, the best desert safaris.

faqs.q: How much is a hotel in Business Bay per night?
faqs.a: For 2 adults on a normal January night, from €86 at Barceló and €91 at Park Regis to €212 at SLS and €290 at ME by Meliá, before taxes. A 5-star with breakfast included starts at €186 (Embassy Suites by Hilton).

faqs.q: Which Business Bay hotel includes breakfast?
faqs.a: Embassy Suites by Hilton includes breakfast for two in its cheapest €186 rate. SLS, InterContinental Residences and Hotel Indigo sell breakfast-included rates at a higher price. Otherwise breakfast costs €17 at Park Regis, €34 at Hotel Indigo and €37 at the InterContinental Residences.

faqs.q: Is Business Bay or Downtown better to stay in?
faqs.a: Business Bay gets you a 9.0-rated 5-star from €109 (Hotel Indigo) and a 9.2 with breakfast for €186 (Embassy Suites). Downtown puts you next to Burj Khalifa and Dubai Mall. ME by Meliá is 2.4 km from Dubai Mall and Park Regis 3 km from Burj Khalifa. Compare both in our Downtown Dubai hotels guide.

faqs.q: What is the best serviced apartment in Business Bay?
faqs.a: For score and service, InterContinental Residences (9.5, 48 m² studio with kitchen, €210). For value, Lusso Hometels Missoni (9.3, 41 m² studio with balcony and washing machine, €129).

faqs.q: Which Business Bay hotel is best for families?
faqs.a: DAMAC Maison Aykon City has three pools, a kids' club and kitchenette studios for €130. Embassy Suites adds a children's buffet and play areas with breakfast in the rate, and Canal Central has a kids' pool and free access to a private beach on the Palm.

faqs.q: Are there beach hotels in Business Bay?
faqs.a: No, Business Bay is on the canal. Two hotels bridge the gap: Canal Central's Superior Room includes free access to its private beach on Palm Jumeirah, and Barceló runs a free shuttle to Kite Beach. For hotels right on the sand, see the best hotels in JBR.

faqs.q: What taxes are added to Dubai hotel prices?
faqs.a: At the 5-star hotels here, a 10% service charge, 5% VAT, a 7% municipality fee and an AED 20 per night tourism fee are added to the room price. Apartments and some hotels also take a refundable damage deposit of AED 200–750.

methodology: We compared 10 Business Bay hotels and serviced apartments for the same night (2 adults, cheapest available room) on live nightly price in euros, guest score and location score, room size, pools, breakfast price, deposits and taxes, and family and pet policies. The shortlist mixes price levels from €86 to €290, big-brand hotels, independents, three apartment-style stays and one design landmark. Hotels that sit in Downtown are covered on our Downtown page instead.
